objetivo: For students to recognize that the Sun is a star around which eight planets orbit due to gravity, distinguish rocky planets from gas planets, and understand why Earth is special.
hatsumon: When you look at the night sky, what's up there, so far away?

turnos.utterance_coloquial: Alright everyone, today we're going to travel without leaving this room: we're going to learn about the solar system.

turnos.utterance_formal: Take out your notebooks and leave yourselves plenty of room, because there's a lot to see today.
